description: Snapshot of active credit card transfer bonuses to airline programs. These change weekly; treat as a monthly snapshot, not live data. Bonus = extra percent of airline points on top of the normal ratio. Several end within days of this snapshot.
sourceNote: Syndicated copy of The Points Guy's October 2026 transfer bonus roundup, dated 2026-10-20.

appGuidance: Recommended: let users enter a bonus percent manually (effective ratio = ratio x (1 + bonus/100)), and optionally show this snapshot with its as-of date.
